predecessorViews.hero: Pouch is wider, blockier and more vertically flat at edges than candidate. Same eyes, brow projection, shallow feet and tail identity.
predecessorViews.01-front: Broad rectangular cream midsection less rounded than candidate; same face expression and shelf feet.
predecessorViews.02-left: Same narrow forefoot and tall rear support; thin diagonal seam at pouch/teal boundary more conspicuous.
predecessorViews.03-right: Flat pouch front and long straight pale side edge; unchanged crown, tail and legs.
predecessorViews.04-back: Essentially same silhouette; lower side cream extent differs, no meaningful rear improvement.
predecessorViews.05-top: Pouch protrudes more broadly ahead of crown; same body, spines, feet and tail.
predecessorViews.06-elevated-front: Wider, more block-like lower face than candidate; eyes and toe repetition shared.
predecessorViews.07-elevated-left: More abrupt pouch side/front facet and seam; same banded crown and legs.
predecessorViews.08-elevated-right: Pouch appears flatter with sharper vertical edge; same feet/tail geometry impression.
predecessorViews.09-elevated-back: No material likeness advantage; same spines and narrow supports.

confidence: Small preference, not perceptually measured precision. Both materially short of original. No comparison to uninspected historical versions is claimed.
